articles.title: Elmore and Grant named in Northern Ireland squad
articles.summary: Sparta Prague forward Kess Elmore is a surprise first call-up for Northern Ireland's 2027 Women's World Cup play-off with Portugal.

articles.title: Ocon to leave Haas at end of 2026 season
articles.summary: Esteban Ocon will leave Haas at the end of the 2026 Formula 1 season, both driver and team have confirmed.
